basic_profile.bio: An avid Yu-Gi-Oh! enthusiast from the sunny state of Arizona, I have been collecting and playing cards since my college days. I'm particularly interested in rare and collectible cards, and I enjoy visiting local card shops to expand my collection. Besides my passion for cards, I maintain a terrarium with a variety of plants and small creatures, and I have a peculiar interest in niche internet subcultures. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to engage with my hobbies during the day. I am currently single and enjoy spending evenings exploring online communities and catching up with the latest episodes of my favorite podcasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep knowledge of collectible trading card games, especially Yu-Gi-Oh!, acquired through years of playing, trading, and community engagement. My interest in terrariums and niche topics like Vore developed from a mix of online exploration and attending local meetups.
